issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event uses abbreviation S4 prime (written S4 apostrophe) without defining what S4 or S4 prime refers to — a new reader cannot infer the program/phase context from the background text alone. The term appears again as S4 in Conversational Texture, also undefined.

background.md Solution Tradeoffs mentions run-recovery with a parenthetical commit hash (e8aca935) that does not exist in the repository (git show e8aca935 returns fatal: unknown revision). The run-recovery files exist under experiments/recovery-runner/ so the exclusion intent is clear, but the stale SHA is a false factual claim.
